sensor_input: Live standing rear depth, calibrated mount, encoder FK, IMU and previous joint targets. Mesh truth only for preflight/evaluation.
test: Original 1000 control ticks, physical and legal predicates, all-episode slip, final 250 ticks, validated contact mapping, plus positive legal torso or rear cover normal load >=5% BW throughout final hold.
repetition: One center development start. Only after pass, two separate simulator starts from the same full standing bank with +/-15 mm lateral starting offsets and different seeds. No motion resets or teacher actions.
resource: Only RTX 4090 UUID bound by existing launcher with renderer single GPU. Per revision at most 3 processes, 600 seconds each, 25 warmup plus 1000 control ticks and 4 physics substeps per control, initialization <=1000 physics steps per start. Recording/reporting CPU only. Stop on first failed trial.
scope: Isolated armchair controller; no PPO, benchmark promotion, material, target region, starting chair pose or action envelope changes.
